reviewer.tool: claude -p (fresh session: no tools, no settings, empty folder)

notes: No item misstates the guide. Three minor points for a human reviewer. (1) /states/0 frames the Default state as 'No mode changes'. The guide only says 'HStack uses its default direction and token rhythm.' Because Slot gap and Padding are passed through modes, this reading is probably intended, but it could be misread as also covering Color Mode or Stack Context. (2) /examples/0 and /examples/1 use a Badge component. The evidence file's list of public exports does not name Badge, though that list is not stated to be exhaustive; confirm against the package types. (3) /examples/2 passes Padding: 'None' into the child Text modes as well as the HStack. The guide says children inherit the mode context, so this is redundant at best. Padding None belongs on the HStack, not on Text, and an agent copying the example might over-apply it.
